Title: Users may experience delays receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 60 minutes.

Title: Users may experience delays receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts users who may be attempting to receive email messages from external domains in Exchange Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 12:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may experience delays sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: Our initial investigation has identified instances where anti-spam protections may be contributing to impact for a subset of users. We are continuing to analyse the behaviour and review service telemetry to better understand the underlying cause and determine the most effective mitigation path.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts users who may be attempting to send and receive email messages from external domains in Exchange Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 12:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may experience delays sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: We've identified that the enforcement of a specific anti-spam model is contributing to impact for a subset of email traffic. We're adding affected IPs from the throttling enforcement to an allow list as an initial mitigation measure. In parallel, we're working to disable the specific model that caused impact.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts users who may be attempting to send and receive email messages from external domains in Exchange Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Title: Users may experience delays sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

We're disabling this specific rule to provide relief and fully mitigate the issue. We expect this to complete within the next hour.

Title: Users may experience delays sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may have experienced a delay in sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may have experienced intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.
Depending on the client, the service should attempt to periodically retry sending the email previously impacted by the issue. If the initial sender received an NDR after 24-72 hours (different clients or email providers can vary), they will need to send a new email.
 
Final status: We've confirmed that the issue is resolved after an extended period of monitoring, and receiving additional confirmations from previously impacted organizations.
 
Scope of impact: This issue impacted users who may have been attempting to send and receive email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.
Start time: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC
 
End time: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 3:15 PM UTC
Preliminary root cause: The enforcement of a specific anti-spam model contributed to impact for a subset of email traffic. We'll provide more details within the Post-Incident Report.
 
Next Steps:
- We're reviewing model classifications, rule configurations and upstream data pipelines to determine why the anti-spam model started to impact a subset of email traffic.
 
We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
